import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, uv, cost, cap;
        int hc, f;

        public Edge(int u, int v, int uv, int cost, int cap, int hc, int f) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.uv = uv;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.hc = hc;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static int N, M, K, T, N_, M_;
    static int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static int[] pi, kk, bb;
    static int[] pq, iq;
    static PriorityQueue<Integer> pqq;
    static int cnt;

    static int i2(int i) {
        return i * 2 > cnt ? 0 : i * 2 < cnt && compare(pq[i * 2 + 1], pq[i]) ? i * 2 + 1 : i * 2;
    }

    static void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i / 2) != 0 && compare(u, pq[j]) != 0; i = j)
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i2(i)) != 0 && compare(pq[j], u) != 0; i = j)
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void pq_add(int u) {
        iq[u] = ++cnt;
        pqq.offer(u);
        pq_up(u);
    }

    static int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];

        iq[v] = 1;
        pq_dn(v);
        pqq.remove(u);
        return u;
    }

    static int compare(int u, int v) {
        if (pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]))
            return -1;
        else if (pi[u] > pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] > kk[v]))
            return 1;
        else
            return 0;
    }

    static void add(int i, int j) {
        aa[i].next = new Edge(aa[i].next, j, i ^ j, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    static void add_(int i, int h) {
        aa_[i].next = new Edge(aa_[i].next, h, i ^ h, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    static int uu[], vv[], uv[], cost[], cap[], cost_, hc[], f[];
    static int[] cc;

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;

        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cap[h] = cap;
        hc[h] = h;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        add_(u, h << 1 ^ 0);
        add_(v, h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(pi, INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        pqq = new PriorityQueue<>((x, y) -> compare(x, y));
        pqq.offer(s);
        while (!pqq.isEmpty()) {
            int u = pqq.poll(), v;
            int h, h_, p, k = kk[u] + 1;

            for (Edge l = aa_[u].next; l != null; l = l.next) {
                if (cc[h_ = l.hc] != 0) {
                    h = h_ >> 1;
                    p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost_[h] : -cost_[h]);
                    v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] == INF) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = k;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pqq.offer(v);
                    } else if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && kk[v] > k)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = k;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pq_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push(int s, int t) {
        int u, h, h_, c = INF;

        for (u = t; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            if (c > cc[h_])
                c = cc[h_];
        }
        for (u = t; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_] -= c;
            cc[h_ ^ 1] += c;
        }
    }

    static int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        System.arraycopy(cost, 0, cost_, 0, m_ * sizeof(int));
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (pi[t] == INF)
                break;
            push(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int u = uu[h], v = vv[h];

                if (pi[u] != INF && pi[v] != INF)
                    cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v];
            }
        }
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int[] ii = new int[K];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
            ii[i] = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
        while (M-- > 0) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int i = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            i--;
            j--;
            add(i, j);
            add(j, i);
        }
        T = N + K + 1;
        N_ = N * T + 1;
        M_ = 0;
        int[] s = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int s_ = 0; s_ < T - 1; s_++) {
                int u = i * T + s_;
                for (Edge l = aa[i].next; l != null; l = l.next) {
                    int j = l.j;
                    int v = j * T + s_ + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= K; x++)
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int s_ = 0; s_ < T - 1; s_++) {
                int u = i * T + s_;
                int v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, K, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
            link(N_ - 1, ii[i] * T, 1, 0);
        System.out.println(edmonds_karp(N_ - 1, 0 * T + T - 1));
    }
}
